notablePrerequisites: Ronin Warclub attached to Skirk Prospector.
description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Koll triggers, returning Skirk Prospector from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Skirk Prospector by paying {R}.
When Skirk Prospector enters the battlefield, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching itself to Skirk Prospector.
Repeat.
